# PottsChainShowBasis

Module: **Spin** · directory: `Spin/src/Programs` · binary: `Spin/src/Programs/PottsChainShowBasis`

```text
PottsChainShowBasis, version 0.01

Usage: PottsChainShowBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -n, --zn : Zn value of the Potts model (default value = 3)
    -p, --nbr-spin : number of spins (default value = 2)
    -q, --q-value : Zn charge (default value = 0)
    -e, --state : name of the file containing the eigenstate to be displayed
```
